lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm Craig, and it's launch night we're sorting out.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm EJ. The venue's booked, so that leaves drinks, food and the music.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And we said the whole evening stays under a thousand, all in.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sotto, what's a reasonable per-head budget for drinks at an evening launch party in London?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And how much of that would just be the glass hire?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Where are you getting that from?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay EJ, what do you actually want to do here, a cash bar or a float behind it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A float, capped. A cash bar makes the whole thing feel like a conference.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Three hundred behind the bar then, and when it's gone it's gone.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That works. Food next. Something cold that can sit out all evening.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nothing that needs a kitchen. The place has one sink and no oven.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So platters. Bread, cheese, something green so it isn't all beige.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And one hot thing at eight, or people complain.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We'd need a plug for that, and there isn't one near the back wall.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There's one by the fire door. Dodgy, but it exists.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Noted. Music, then. A playlist, or do we pay somebody?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A playlist. Nobody has ever remembered the DJ at a thing like this.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Agreed. I'll put one together and we can argue about it later.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sotto, do we need a licence to play recorded music at a private launch event in the UK?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's roughly what I assumed. We'll sort it with the venue.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They'll have one. Most places do.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll ask them anyway, so it's in writing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. Invites, then. This week, or wait until the food is confirmed?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: This week. People book up, and the food won't change what night it is.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: True. I'll draft something tonight and send it round.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perfect. Drinks, food, music and invites. I think we're done.

wakeQuestions.question: What is a reasonable per-head budget for drinks at an evening launch party in London?
Do we need a licence to play recorded music at a private launch event in the UK?
